test_name: A plain score engraves at the magnification its config set!s: 1 (session 35)
description: The engine's score defaults on, no \magnifyStaff in the score, cnb:default-magnify set! to 1 after the include. Measured on 2.24 and 2.26: the staff symbol is 4.0 tall (the engine's default staff, four staff spaces at magnification 1) and the default notehead 1.0 x 1.0. The same file at 7/4 gives a staff 7.0 tall and a notehead 1.75 x 1.75, and before session 35 this file gave those too, because the score defaults read the variable when the engine was included.

assertions.description: The staff is 4.0 tall: 1 of the 4-space staff, 4/7 of 7/4's 7.0
The first notehead is drawn at magnification 1: 1.0 tall (1.75 at 7/4)
